title: frontend / privacy.export_requested (v1) data payload
description: A data-portability request. Published to the 'frontend.events' exchange with routing key 'privacy.export_requested'; each owning service replies with privacy.data_provided, the Control Room assembles the bundle, Mailing delivers it. (ADR-0009.)

requestId.description: Correlates the export across services and the assembled bundle.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId whose data is exported.

requestedBy.description: Whether the data subject or an admin initiated the export.

adminActor.description: The admin account when requestedBy = admin; null when self-initiated.

at.description: When the export was requested (RFC3339 UTC).
